# The CurioVault Facts

> Discover What Others Don't Know.

The CurioVault Facts is an education brand sharing verified amazing facts about
space, nature, the human body, history and science — as short posts, posters and
short-form videos (Reels / YouTube Shorts).

## Facts on this site

- Mantis shrimp: their punch is one of the fastest strikes in the animal kingdom.
- The Moon is drifting away from Earth by about 3.8 cm every year.
- The first oranges were not orange — they were green, from Southeast Asia.
- The placebo effect works even when people know they are taking a placebo.
- The Sahara Desert was green thousands of years ago, with lakes and rivers.
- The first gigabyte hard drive (IBM 3380, 1980) weighed about 250 kg.
- The shortest war in history lasted about 38 minutes (Anglo-Zanzibar War, 1896).
- There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.

## About

The CurioVault Facts publishes one new set of facts every day: posts, posters and
short videos, all written in simple English so anyone can learn something new in
under a minute.
